title: Long-term perturbation of the blood transcriptome months after SARS-CoV-2 infection.
description: Blood collected from recovered COVID-19 patients at 12, 16 and 24 weeks post infection was found to retain a signature of active infection which was associated with severity of disease Overall design: Total RNA sequenced from healthy controls, and from recovered COVID-19 patients at 12, 16 and 24 weeks post infection
